title: Signed cubic ideal scheduling and genback
objective: Implement PARI 2.17.4 generic signed cubic extended-ideal multiply square invert power scheduling and bounded genback over compact ordered factors with exact source replay
references: PARI 2.17.4 base4.c idealpowred/idealred0/idealHNF_inv_Z and buch2.c genback

handoff.summary: Added ordinary source-transparent Python for ordered compact-factor square/append, exact cubic ideal-HNF multiply and scaled inverse, PARI-style signed idealpowred scheduling for exponents -3..3, and connected two-prime genback. Frozen controls reproduce six signed powers and P_191^3*P_193^-2 exactly against pristine PARI 2.17.4, CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged native backends, including independent principal-ideal identities.
risks: T2/LLL candidate selection remains an explicit exact tape boundary rather than direct wiring to the existing connected selector.
Exponents are deliberately restricted to -3..3 and HNF product/inverse moduli must fit below 2^64.
The implementation is specialized to the frozen totally real cubic; arbitrary degree and final class-group/unit result construction remain integration work.
next_steps: Wire the existing T2/LLL selector to the candidate boundary and replay the same exact fixtures without a tape.
Lift exponent and modulus bounds only when an authenticated class_group_gen trace demonstrates the required range.
Use the connected genback result in final unit reconstruction and immutable result replay.
